correctness.rationale: At equilibrium \(xF_J(x)=Ky\) and \(yF_J(y)=-Kx\). Opposite signs of \(F_J\) force the coordinate with positive \(F_J\) into \(|u|<m_J\) when \(K\ge J-1\), contradiction. Origin has eigenvalues \(J-1\pm iK\) and repels. Every other bounded planar orbit eventually excludes the sole fixed point, so Poincare-Bendixson forces a periodic omega-limit. Direct algebra proves the strict tanh angular inequality; each cycle has winding one, yielding the two strict period bounds. The companion finite checker corroborates 50,000, 175 and 7,000 instances; no finite check was mistaken for proof.

value.rationale: An explicit unbounded robust mean-field swap-cycle parameter sector, valid globally for all nonzero initial data, is a motivated mathematical strengthening of the published primarily numerical phase diagram. The guaranteed period ceiling in a strict sub-sector provides a quantitative oscillation rate independent of initial preparation, with physical value for selecting deterministic oscillatory parameters. This is a sufficient theorem, not a purported exact phase boundary or a routine one-parameter numerical sample.
